We must see if any statements conflict. The dialogue is about Taylor's product ownership, metrics, artifacts, etc. Look for prior commitments that are later changed.

Key points:

- Initially Taylor says Q2 2022 redesign, metrics, etc. Later provides weekly metrics, artifacts, etc. No contradictions.

- At some point product_vp says "Since those have not been provided, we cannot confirm product-evidence claim at this time." (message 12542). That's consistent: they got artifacts later, so they can confirm. Not contradictory.

- Any contradictions about metrics? Initially says abandonment dropped to 24% within two weeks, revenue up 12%. Later weekly metrics show week1 24% abandonment, week2 23% etc. Consistent.

- At one point product_vp asks for specific artifacts, Taylor says will share later. Later provides excerpts. No contradictions.

- Engineering director earlier says "technical spike excerpt shows engineers' proposed solution..." later confirms engineering evidence satisfied. Consistent.

- Leadership evidence: People partner confirms.

- Any changed information about latency target? Initially target <150ms. Later performance test shows 148ms meeting target. Consistent.

- Any contradictory statements about who owned what? Taylor says owned hypothesis, experiment design, stakeholder alignment, rollout coordination. Later says engineers led implementation. Consistent.

- Any contradictory about timeline? Initially says launch cut abandonment to 24% and lifted revenue 12%. Later weekly metrics show week1 24% abandonment, revenue $5.20 etc. Consistent.

- Any contradictory about risk register entry: earlier risk register excerpt says Owner: Noah Williams. Later technical spike also says Owner: Noah Williams. Consistent.

- Any contradictory about priority board: earlier summary says top items include launch loyalty badge, hit <150ms, improve mobile flow. Later excerpt shows Loyalty Badge | Score 8/10 | Owner: Taylor Morgan. Consistent.

- Any contradictory about who confirmed evidence: product_vp confirms product evidence, engineering director confirms engineering evidence, people partner confirms leadership evidence. All consistent.

Thus overall temporal coherence seems clear: no contradictions, just progression.

Therefore classification: clear.
